jobs.description: Your missionAbout the roleWe are looking for an experienced Financial Controller to take ownership of our monthly accounting and closing process, IFRS reporting and the finance side of our upcoming ERP implementation. manage the audit process and resolve audit findings• Support statutory reporting, tax filings and group reporting requirementsERP implementation and finance systems• Represent Finance as process owner in the ERP implementation and process• Define requirements for chart of accounts, workflows, reporting and controls; document target processes• Lead data migration, testing (UAT), go-live and post-go-live stabilization for finance modules• Train finance team members and business users• Drive automation and continuous improvement of finance processesInternal controls and team leadership• Design, implement and monitor an internal control system (ICS) with appropriate segregation of duties• Lead, coach and develop the accounting teamYour profile Required• Degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a comparable field• Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CIMA, ACA• 3+ years of experience in accounting or controlling, ideally including time at an audit firm• Proven track record running monthly closings independently• Solid, hands-on HGB and IFRS knowledge, including consolidation• Experience with ERP systems• Strong Excel skills and comfort with reporting and BI tools• Fluent in English and GermanPersonal skills• Structured, detail-oriented and reliable under deadline pressure• Hands-on mindset: comfortable both setting strategy and doing the work• Clear communicator who can explain financial topics to non-finance colleagues• Leadership skills and a collaborative approachWhy us?• A high-impact role with direct access to senior management• The opportunity to shape finance processes and systems from the ground up• Competitive salary plus bonus/benefits• Flexible working arrangements with min 3 days per week on siteAbout usEyeSense GmbH is an innovative medical technology company – a spin-off of the pharmaceutical group Novartis – backed by strong investors and offering outstanding prospects for the future. We develop intelligent biosensors for diabetes, diagnostics and lifestyle applications, addressing some of the fastest-growing healthcare markets worldwide. Following excellent development results, our first product received regulatory approval in 2026. We pursue our ambitious projects with great enthusiasm and dedication. Our employees work hand in hand, combining their expertise and commitment to successfully meet the challenges that lie ahead.

Our missionEvery 3 seconds, somewhere in the world, a person develops dementia. Today, more than 55 million people worldwide are living with dementia, and due to the aging population, this number is expected to rise to 78 million by 2030 and 139 million by 2050. The World Health Organization therefore classifies dementia as a public health priority. Even though dementia is still incurable, there have been significant developments in this field recently: disease-modifying drugs for the early stages of Alzheimer's disease have now been approved for the first time. We have made it our mission to enable early medical assessment and continuous monitoring of memory problems associated with Alzheimer's disease. That is why we have developed digital cognitive tests that are embedded in smartphone apps and can be used in research or healthcare.Your responsibilitiesneotiv develops digital cognitive assessments to detect and monitor cognitive impairment along the Alzheimer’s disease continuum. Our assessments are used as outcome measures in pharma-sponsored clinical trials and academic studies. To strengthen our Science & Innovation Team, we are looking for a Project Manager Study Coordination (35 hours/week, based in Magdeburg, Berlin, or remotely) who will take responsibility for delivering these studies from setup to close-out, serving as the main point of contact for sponsors, CROs, and study sites. The position is fixed-term until 31 January 2028 as parental leave cover, with the prospect of an extension or a permanent position.• Plan, set up, run and close studies and clinical trials in which neotiv assessments are used, including milestone and timeline tracking against contractual scopes of work.• Act as the main point of contact for sponsors, CROs, academic partners and study sites, and build and maintain strong working relationships with them.• Coordinate the study setup and configuration of the neotivPortal and neotivTrials app, including user acceptance testing (UAT) with the sponsor.• Plan and deliver site and study-team trainings and prepare onboarding materials, also in multiple languages.• Prepare study documentation and protocols, and support ethics/IRB and funding applications.• Manage change requests and scope questions in close alignment with our product, development and support teams.• Help acquire new project partners and keep track of scientific developments relevant to neotiv.Your profile• MSc in Psychology, Neuroscience, Neurology, Medicine or a related field. A PhD is an advantage.• 3–5 years of professional experience managing clinical and/or academic research studies. Experience on the vendor or technology-provider side of clinical trials (e.g. digital biomarker, CRO or similar), working with pharma sponsors, is strongly preferred.• Good knowledge of the clinical trial setting, ideally including ethics/IRB submissions, site training and sponsor/CRO collaboration.• Experience leading project teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders and workstreams in parallel.• Interest in and knowledge of cognitive neuroscience and neurodegeneration. Knowledge of digital health and precision medicine is a plus.• Fluent German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.• Confident use of Microsoft 365 and common project management tools (Jira/Confluence).• A reliable, structured way of working with a strong eye for detail, and the ability to stay calm and flexible when timelines or requirements change.• Willingness to travel occasionally.What we have to offer• Flexible working from our offices in Magdeburg and Berlin, or from home.• Flexible working hours and 30 days of annual leave.• Monthly benefits worth €65 net (mobility allowance, non-cash benefit and/or Urban Sports Club membership).• A childcare allowance of up to €135 net per month, if needed.• An occupational pension scheme, with the employer contribution rising to up to 80% with length of service.• A training budget for your professional and personal development.• Monthly Creative Days for new ideas, collaboration and room to develop creatively.• A great team that enjoys its work and is committed to high standards of quality and professionalism.Your point of contactSend us your CV and cover letter, addressed to our People & Culture Team. If you have questions, we are happy to answer them by email at jobs@neotiv.com or by phone.About usneotiv is a team of currently about 30 people: Scientists, developers and technically enthusiastic people who share a common vision of a better prevention of dementia. We develop digital solutions for the early detection and monitoring of memory problems.neotiv is a spin-off from Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg in close cooperation with the German Centre for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE). Our team is passionate about shaping the future of medical care with digital tools and advancing dementia research. We work in Magdeburg, Berlin and across Germany and Europe. We are funded by renowned investors and science transfer funds that enable us to realize our mission of improving people's lives.

Good to know...Hybrid with a flexible office policy · Based in Germany, with regular travel to Berlin · Full-time · Reports to the Head of GrowthPets Deli has grown into a leading premium pet food D2C brand in Germany, with recipes developed by veterinarians, a loyal customer base, and a marketing engine built around measurable results.You own how we measure the brand and what we invest in it. You work closely with our performance, creative, influencer, and country teams, and you manage the agencies and research partners behind the work.You start from a strong brand. You can be based anywhere in Germany, provided you are able to travel to our Berlin office regularly.Your tasksBrand Building & Reach• Develop the brand building activities that increase awareness and reach beyond our performance channels, and run them end to end with our agencies and partners: objective, target audience, channels (for example TV, connected TV, out-of-home, PR, and partnerships), briefing, production, and media.• Connect brand building with the performance, creative, and influencer teams, so that product launches, seasonal pushes, and brand activities tell one story across the customer journey.• Work with the country teams on how our positioning and messages translate to new markets, and support building the brand there.Customer Insights & Positioning• Build a clear understanding of our customers, potential customers, category, and competitors through research and customer feedback (for example brand tracking, surveys, interviews, and message tests), and decide which insights matter most for our decisions.• Sharpen our positioning and messaging: what Pets Deli stands for, what makes us different, and the core messages and claims every channel can work with.• Make the insights land: translate them into clear direction for the marketing, creative, and product teams, and make sure it shows up in the work.Brand Strength & Effectiveness• Make brand strength measurable: define the few indicators we steer on and keep them tracked in Germany and the new markets.• Define up front what each brand building activity should achieve and measure it afterwards (for example brand lift studies, geo tests, and the effect on commercial results).• Build our understanding of what drives the brand and what brand building returns, analyze the results, and define where to invest next.The specific focus and priorities across these areas will evolve with the business. You will be expected to identify opportunities, make recommendations, and shape the roadmap in collaboration with the Head of Growth and other stakeholders.Your Profile• Several years of experience in brand building, brand strategy, insights, or marketing communications, on the brand side or in an agency, ideally for D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brands.• Hands-on experience planning and executing brand building across multiple channels, including ATL channels such as TV, connected TV, or out-of-home.• The ability to turn consumer research, market insights, and customer feedback into clear marketing strategies and actionable recommendations.• Strong strategic and analytical thinking: you are comfortable with brand tracking, brand lift studies, and the data behind them, and you can explain what brand building returns in commercial terms.• An understanding of how different marketing channels complement one another and how to connect brand, creative, and performance marketing.• Experience briefing and managing external agencies and media partners, with the confidence to challenge recommendations and drive high-quality execution.• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence and collaborate across teams without relying on formal authority.• A pragmatic, hands-on approach and the ability to move between strategic thinking and execution, taking ownership in a fast-moving environment.• The ability to balance consistent brand positioning with local market needs. Experience working across multiple markets is a plus.• Native or near-native German and fluent English. Dutch is a plus.Are we a match?A lot works differently here than in a classic company:• We try things out, decide quickly and correct just as quickly.• You carry real responsibility. And where nobody is in charge, you step in.• Results count, not hours or titles. Decisions are made on facts, not on hierarchy.• We say openly what we think: directly, in every direction and with respect.• Obstacles do not knock us off course, and constantly learning something new is what drives us.If fixed structures, stable priorities or titles matter more to you than moving things forward, you will not be happy with us.Your Chances• The opportunity to shape how Pets Deli builds its brand and measures what it returns, in Germany and across new markets.• Meaningful ownership from day one, including agency and research budgets and direct access to the Head of Growth and leadership team.• Close collaboration with our growth, creative, and influencer teams, with the opportunity to shape how marketing works across the

About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionLooking to translate standards like ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, and Part-IS into practice within highly complex aerospace environments? Develop your GRC expertise further within our teamWe take responsibility for ensuring that people worldwide can fly safely and that modern aviation systems are protected from cyber threats. At Airbus Protect, we combine the expertise of over 1,600 specialists across cybersecurity, safety, and sustainability. Together, we secure the Airbus Group, critical infrastructure, and global industrial partnersFor this position, two primary locations are available and can be specified in your employment contract upon mutual agreement:- Munich / Ottobrunn: Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful state capital of Bavaria. Do you enjoy sports and outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg can be reached within an hour, offering a wide range of leisure opportunities- Hamburg / Finkenwerder: You will work at Airbus’s largest production site for civil aircraft in Hamburg. Located on the south bank of the Elbe River, you have the option to commute by ferry.
